name: Meeting my weird parents-in-law
source:
Aïcha is an Algerian lesbian Muslim woman living in France but, more importantly, she is deeply in love with her supportive and wonderful girlfriend, Judith. And what happens when a relationship has been healthy for long enough? Exactly: you meet your parents-in-law! But what is the outcome to expect, when they are white, catholic and racist?

Spend the worst day of your life but hey, at least your girlfriend doesn’t buy their shit either, so… it’ll make your love grow bigger????

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/mmwpil-aicha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Aïcha是一位居住在法国的阿尔及利亚裔女同性恋穆斯林女性，但更重要的是，她深爱着体贴又温柔的女友Judith。健康稳定的恋情发展到一定阶段会发生什么？没错，该见岳父母了！可当对方是白人、天主教徒又带有种族偏见时，结果会怎样？

度过人生中最糟糕的一天吧。不过至少你的女友也不吃她父母那一套，所以……说不定你们的感情反而会更深？？？？

[来源：[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/mmwpil-aicha]itch.io[/url]]
